tasks.purpose: 比较两个公园的访客量
tasks.setting:
The grouped bar chart below shows the number of visitors to two town parks during four months of one year. The figures are expressed in thousands and count visits to each park, including repeated visits by the same person.

Grouped bar chart: visits (thousands)
Month     April  May  June  July
North        10   15    20    25
South        20   20    15    10
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两座公园的主要差异，并用数据支持比较。
tasks.model:
The bar chart compares visits to two town parks in four months, from April to July. The values are measured in thousands of visits, so an individual visiting more than once is counted on each occasion.

Overall, visits to North Park increased over the period, while the figure for South Park was stable at first and then fell. South was more popular in the first two months, but North received more visits in June and July.

In April, South Park had 20,000 visits, exactly twice North Park's 10,000. The number visiting South remained at 20,000 in May, whereas North rose to 15,000, reducing the gap to 5,000. The two parks then exchanged positions: in June, North recorded 20,000 visits and South had 15,000.

The contrast was greatest in July. North reached 25,000 visits, its highest figure in the chart, while South dropped to 10,000, its lowest. Thus the difference between the parks widened to 15,000 in North's favour. Across the four months, North gained 15,000 visits per month, whereas South lost 10,000.

tasks.purpose: 比较两类交通方式的使用人数
tasks.setting:
The grouped bar chart below compares the numbers of pupils who travelled to school by bicycle and by bus in four districts in a single term. Each figure is given in hundreds of pupils and refers to the principal mode used.

Grouped bar chart: pupils (hundreds)
District       A   B   C   D
Bicycle        2   4   6   8
Bus            8   6   4   2
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括不同地区的主要差异，并用数据支持比较。
tasks.model:
The bar chart shows how many pupils in four districts mainly travelled to school by bicycle or bus during one term. The figures are given in hundreds of pupils.

Overall, the number cycling increased from district A to district D, while the number using buses decreased by the same amount. Bus travel was more common in the first two districts, whereas cycling was the more common mode in the last two.

In district A, 200 pupils cycled, compared with 800 who used the bus. The bus figure was therefore four times the cycling figure. In district B, the number of cyclists was twice that in A, at 400, while the number of bus users was lower, at 600. The difference between the two modes narrowed from 600 pupils in A to 200 in B.

The pattern reversed in district C, where 600 pupils cycled and 400 travelled by bus. In district D, the respective figures were 800 and 200. The gap there was 600 pupils, matching the size of the gap in A but favouring the opposite mode. Each district had a combined total of 1,000 pupils across these two categories.
